summary:
Tested bulk-delete email accounts endpoint + HTML mode in RichTextEditor (Campaign editor) end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_delete_accounts.py with 7 pytest cases — all passing: empty list → 400, no session → 401, cross-user silent skip (deleted:0, skipped:N), happy path (deleted:N + safety counts for campaigns/email_queue/drip_contacts/replies unchanged), active 'running' campaign block + requires_force=true + force override deletes only the account_row (campaign doc + account_ids preserved), active drip block, completed-status campaign does NOT block. Frontend Playwright e2e: Select-all in /accounts toolbar → bulk-delete-accounts button visible → bulk-delete-dialog opens with confirmation copy → Cancel closes it. Campaign create page → editor-html-mode-toggle clicks, rich-text-editor-html textarea appears, paste '

Hi {first_name}

xbold' → toggle back → sanitized HTML in contentEditable: '

Hi {first_name}

xbold' (script removed, javascript: URL neutered, {first_name} preserved, bold preserved). No issues found. Backend success 100%, frontend critical path success 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py bulk_delete_accounts: when force=true skips both campaign and drip checks — correct per spec. Logging line emits user.email and count — good. No transaction wrapping delete_many, but acceptable since it's idempotent (delete_many on absent ids is a no-op).

RichTextEditor.sanitizeForEmail: DOMPurify config drops javascript: URLs via ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP but the surviving <a> tag becomes href-less (anchors with no href). That's acceptable for sanitization but you may want to strip such empty anchors entirely for cleaner email HTML.

RichTextEditor toggleHtmlMode: when switching back to visual, editorRef.current.innerHTML is assigned directly. If user is mid-edit with selection/cursor in visual mode, that selection is silently dropped — minor UX nit, not a bug.

EmailAccounts.jsx bulk-delete-dialog handles both confirm-prompt and 'requires_force' second screen in the SAME AlertDialog — Cancel button label/state correctly differentiates. Verified the second screen renders active_campaigns / active_drips names from API response.
Backend: drip_id-based active_drips filter uses status in ['running','scheduled'] (no 'sending') — per spec. Campaign filter uses ['running','scheduled','sending'] — also per spec. Consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — bulk-delete dialog + HTML mode sanitization verified

test_credentials: drip.tester@example.com / DripTest123! (used). Second user created/cleaned: TEST_bulkdel_<uuid>@example.com.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_bd_* seed accounts/campaigns/drips are created per-test and cleaned up in the autouse fixture. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_delete_accounts.py (7 tests, all passing). Verifies: (a) endpoint contract, (b) safety — campaigns/email_queue/drip_contacts/replies counts unchanged after bulk-delete, (c) force-override preserves campaign doc and account_ids array. Frontend verified: bulk-delete-accounts + bulk-delete-dialog + cancel-bulk-delete + confirm-bulk-delete data-testids render correctly; editor-html-mode-toggle + rich-text-editor-html data-testids work in Campaign create flow. DripCampaignView uses the same RichTextEditor component (verified by code reference) so the same HTML toggle appears in /drip-campaigns/{id}; e2e click-through wasn't completed in this run because the Drip card 'Open' button click selector matched the sidebar nav link instead — non-blocking, code share guarantees parity.
